name: Lal Mirchi - Agnitra Spices
description: Sun-dried Kashmiri chillies ground in slow-rotating stone chakkis. Keeps grinding temperatures below 38°C to retain natural red pigment and pure capsaicin oils. Gives mild heat with rich deep red color and sweet aroma.
benefits: Rich in Vitamin C and natural antioxidants
Locks essential oils without artificial colors
usage: Perfect for curries, tandoori marinades, stews, and daily cooking where rich red color and warmth are desired.
recipes: Add 1 tsp to tandoori marinades for natural coloring.
Stir into slow-cooked gravies at the end to lock aroma.

name: Haldi - Agnitra Spices
description: Premium turmeric rhizomes sun-dehydrated and hand-pounded in traditional wooden and stone mortar-pestles (Okhli). Prevents thermal degradation, preserving active Curcumin (>5.2%) and natural turmeric oils.
benefits: Super-high Curcumin content (>5.2%) for powerful immunity support
Natural immunity booster with antimicrobial properties
Pure golden yellow texture without lead chromate or starch fillers
usage: Use in daily cooking, traditional Golden Milk, skincare masks, or natural wellness shots.
recipes: Golden Milk: Whisk 1/2 tsp turmeric in hot milk with honey.
Daily Tadka: Add 1/2 tsp to heated ghee/oil to activate curcumin.

name: Dhaniya - Agnitra Spices
description: Freshly selected coriander seeds (Dhania) dry-roasted in sun-baked clay pans, then stone-ground in traditional hand-mills. Retains high concentrations of Linalool for a citrusy, herbal fragrance.
benefits: Excellent source of dietary fiber and minerals
Helps regulate digestion and blood sugar
Fresh cooling digestive spice with zero metal dust contamination
usage: A cooling base spice for gravies, vegetable stir-fries, lentil dal, and traditional spice rubs.
recipes: Stir 1 tbsp into dals and curries for a balanced earthiness.
Blend with cumin and black pepper for homemade masala.

name: Khadi Mirch - Agnitra Spices
description: Premium sun-dried whole red chillies carefully hand-picked from Byadgi farms. Retains natural stem and full capsaicin seeds for authentic Indian tempering (Tadka) and whole spice blends.
benefits: 100% Whole sun-dried red chillies with intact seeds
Rich in natural antioxidants and capsaicin
Ideal for aromatic tadka and homemade chili flakes
usage: Ideal for tempering dal, kadhai curries, pickles, or crushing for fresh chili flakes.
recipes: Tadka: Crack 2 whole pods in hot ghee with cumin for dal tempering.
Grind into fresh coarse chilli flakes for pasta & pizza.

name: Sabut Dhaniya - Agnitra Spices
description: Hand-harvested whole coriander seeds from Ramganj Mandi. Carefully sun-dried to preserve natural Linalool aromatic oils. Perfect for freshly roasting and grinding at home.
benefits: Whole fragrant seeds rich in dietary fiber and essential oils
usage: Roast lightly on a dry pan to unlock intense citrusy aromas before crushing or grinding.
recipes: Dry roast 2 tbsp seeds and coarse crush for Kadhai Paneer.
Boil 1 tsp in water for a refreshing coriander detox tea.
